review_type: worker self-review only; not formal acceptance
method: Inspected complete built-in generated images and invoked view_image on preserved copies/selected file. Pillow pixel samples used only to estimate framing; no image editing.

criteria.criterion: One original adult masked humanoid representative
criteria.evidence: Single adult male, dark fitted coif and mask, natural eyes/brow; original generic stealth-troop design, no actor likeness request.

criteria.criterion: Distinct from owner identity and costume
criteria.evidence: Male masked cloth troop with subdued crimson waist accent, no red Elektra costume, long sash, headband, hair silhouette or paired weapons.

Head/chest/pelvis read frontal and centered without obvious three-quarter body turn. Feet turn slightly outward in a relaxed stance. True mathematical camera projection cannot be certified from a generated raster.

criteria.criterion: Relaxed bent arms and limb gaps
criteria.evidence: Both elbows mildly bent, both arms separated from torso with background gaps; visible gap between legs.

criteria.criterion: Hands visible; one short sword in own RIGHT hand; own LEFT hand empty
criteria.evidence: Viewer-left hand securely holds one lowered diagonal-outward sword; viewer-right hand empty with relaxed curved fingers. Wrist, guard and blade distinguishable; gripping fingers naturally occluded, so every digit cannot be independently counted.

criteria.criterion: Entire figure, headgear, sword and pedestal uncropped
criteria.evidence: Full coif, hands, blade tip, boots and both pedestal tiers remain inside frame.
Visual/pixel samples place top around y=96 of 1536 (6.25%); requested y=92.16 (6%).
Correction placed the bottom around y=1318 of 1536 (85.81%), leaving about 14.19% below, instead of requested 10%.

criteria.criterion: Single dark two-disc stone pedestal edge-on, no visible top
criteria.evidence: Exactly two dark stone side faces and near-level horizontal boundaries; no appreciable exposed upper ellipse in corrected result. Round plan shape is intended but cannot be proven from an edge-on raster.
No scene or floor; background remains a subtle charcoal lighting gradient/vignette instead of perfectly uniform charcoal. Faint diffuse shading remains below base.

criteria.criterion: No extra weapons, VFX, scenery, text, UI or franchise insignia
criteria.evidence: One figure and one sword only; no visible lettering, logo, VFX, extra weapons or ground scene.

actual_remaining_failures: Charcoal background has a subtle gradient/vignette; faint diffuse shading remains below base.
correction_effect: Improved top margin and eliminated appreciable exposed pedestal top; base-bottom position regressed. No third call permitted.
limitations: Single raster front design only; no back/side views, model, topology, rig, animation, textures, gameplay integration or game-scale testing.
Costume, mask, sword and palette placement are proposed art choices; only owner/count/stats are confirmed by raw/live evidence.
Visual originality is a design intent and no franchise key art, actor image, commercial scan or external generator was used.
The no-prior-source assertion relies on owner-evidence plus a local path scan; one unrelated inaccessible metadata directory was not exhaustively searched.
